Subject: Follow-up: Security questionnaire & evidence — post-demo recap

Hi Asha / MedSecure team,

Thanks again for taking time today — appreciated the thoughtful questions from your security and procurement groups. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we can kick off the questionnaire work without back-and-forth: 

- Scope: You asked about SOC 2, GDPR/HIPAA applicability, and whether we can complete a vendor questionnaire (you mentioned CAIQ as an option). Please confirm whether MedSecure prefers CAIQ, SIG, or a custom XLS for intake.
- Data types: Confirming on our side — Redwood may process user content (text) and account metadata; customers can enable PHI processing in private deployments only. Can you confirm whether the evaluation will assume PHI/PHI-like data in scope? That affects the BAA ask.
- SOC 2: We are SOC 2 Type II (report issued 2026-11-15). We can share the report under an NDA / secure link — confirm the preferred delivery mechanism.
- Evidence submission: We propose a staged delivery: CAIQ prefill + evidence map within 48 hours of intake, followed by direct evidence links (read-only Drive links) for key control families within 7 business days. If you need hard copies or vendor portal uploads, tell us your preference.
- Timeline & owners: Suggested target — questionnaire returned in 5 business days; supporting evidence delivered in 10 business days. Point of contact for procurement to route contracting/BAA: procurement@medsecure.com (cc'd).

Attachments: I can attach a CAIQ prefill template or a short sample evidence map — let me know which you prefer.

Next step: Please reply with your preferred intake format (CAIQ / SIG / custom), whether PHI is in scope, and any must-have controls for immediate priority (e.g., encryption key mgmt, multi-factor auth telemetry, incident response SLA).

Thanks — happy to jump on a short follow-up if you want to walk through the CAIQ mapping.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive — Strategic
Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.ai

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the recap — useful. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Intake format: Our infosec team prefers the CAIQ (cloud-focused) for initial triage because it maps directly to our internal control matrix. We may request targeted SIG questions later for procurement.
- PHI scope: Yes — for evaluation purposes we will treat the environment as potentially PHI-bearing. That will trigger a BAA requirement and additional evidence around access controls, logging, and encryption.
- SOC 2: Please share the latest SOC 2 Type II report (or a SOC2 summary with scope + period). We typically require the full report under a secure transfer method (SFTP or secure drive link).
- Evidence uploads: We prefer read-only drive links for initial evidence; for final verification we may request uploads to our vendor portal.

Attached: MedSecure-SIG-Intent.pdf — note that procurement will follow up on contractual items once technical signoff is achieved.

Can you also confirm who on your side will own the evidence collection (point person for technical asks)?

Regards,
Asha Patel
Vendor Security Manager
MedSecure Inc

Hi Asha — thanks, that all makes sense. A few points + confirmation of next steps from our side: 

1) Intake & timeline
- We will send a CAIQ prefill in XLS form (attached as a stub) within 48 hours. That will include control-level references and short evidence pointers.
- Evidence delivery: read-only Drive links for key artifacts (SOC 2 summary/report, architecture diagram, key rotation docs, IAM policies) within 7 business days of your confirmation.

2) PHI / BAA
- We can support environments that process PHI, but a BAA is required for any PHI-handling customer. We can start the DocuSign BAA in parallel; I'll create the DocuSign link and cc procurement. Please confirm the procurement contact to sign.

3) SOC 2 availability
- Redwood is SOC 2 Type II (report period ended 2026-11-15). We will share the full report under secure transfer (Doc link) once mutual TOU/NDA or an approved sharing mechanism is in place. 

4) Specific asks you flagged — please confirm priority order:
   - MFA and privileged access controls (we'll map Authentication controls)
   - Encryption at-rest + key management (we use customer-managed keys for Private deployments; cloud KMS for hosted tiers)
   - Logging/retention windows (we keep request logs for X days by default; configurable per contract)
   - Incident response / breach notification SLA

5) Owners
- Primary evidence owner on our side: Neha Kapoor (neha@redwood.ai) — she will coordinate artifacts with our security team. 
- Commercial/procurement owner: Marissa Cole (marissa@redwood.ai) — will coordinate contracting/BAA.

I attached a short CAIQ prefill stub (redwood_caiq_prefill.xlsx) and a SOC2 summary (SOC2-Redwood-TypeII-summary.pdf). If you prefer SFTP for the full report, let us know the endpoint and a point-of-contact.

I'll also open a HubSpot ticket and include the ticket link in a follow-up. Looking forward to your confirmation on intake format and PHI scope.

Best,
Sofia
